jewellery.english:
A: Apart from the standard items you'll find lying around in the dungeon, you
might also stumble upon artefacts which come in two varieties:

* randart: a random artefact, usually a weapon, armour or jewellery, with
  random properties such as conferring resistances or abilities.

* unrandart: a rarer variety of artefact that is predefined instead of randomly
  generated. Most unrandarts are identified on sight, and some come with
  special effects or unique abilities that are not available elsewhere.

Artefacts cannot be rebranded. They also normally cannot be enchanted, but
the artefact enchanting mutation allows scrolls of enchant weapon and enchant
armour to improve randart weapons and armour up to the normal enchantment
limits for mundane items of the same type. Unrandarts cannot be enchanted even
with this mutation.
jewellery.chinese:
A: 除了散落在地牢中的普通物品，你还可能遇到神器。神器分为两类：

* randart：随机神器，通常是武器、护甲或饰品，具有随机属性，
  例如提供抗性或能力。

* unrandart：较罕见的非随机神器，其属性预先定义，而非随机生成。
  大多数非随机神器一眼就能鉴定出来，只有一部分带有其他地方无法获得的
  特殊效果或独特能力。

所有神器都不能被暂时或永久地重新铭印。神器通常也不能附魔；
但拥有“神器附魔”变异时，可以用武器附魔卷轴或护甲附魔卷轴
强化随机神器武器或随机神器护甲，且不能超过同类普通物品的强化上限。
非随机神器即使拥有该变异也不能附魔。

jewellery.english:
<h>Searching the stash-tracker</h>

You can search for items and dungeon features by name (or a substring of the
name). In the list of search results, you can select a search result by its
hotkey to travel to its location.

Some examples of search strings:
<w>mutation</w>      find all potions of mutation, including potions in shops.
<w>throwing net</w>  finds every single throwing net and piles of nets.
<w>shop</w>          lists all shops. Press <w>!</w> and a shop's letter for the stock.
<w>Lair:2</w>        find everything known to be on Lair:2.
<w>/D:[2-4]</w>      finds everything on Dungeon levels 2-4. Regexes are allowed!
              Note that /D:[3-10] will not work as intended, since [x-y] is a
              regex character range.
<w>rPois</w>         finds all items with an rPois resistance.
<w>rC++</w>          finds all items with an rC++ resistance.
<w>+3</w>            finds all items with a +3 enchantment.
<w>/Lair.*axe</w> and <w>axe && Lair</w> both show all axes in the Lair.

Some shortcuts:
<w>.</w>             lists everything on your current level.
<w>..</w>            lists all items you know.
<w>0</w> to <w>9</w>        lists all items at the specified waypoint.
<w>*</w>             lists all items at all waypoints.
<w>@<<query></w>      lists everything matching <<query> on your current level.
<w>/<<regex></w>      lists items matching <<regex> as a regular expression.
<w>=<<string></w>     lists items containing <<string> as a substring.

You can also examine shops and items in the search results by pressing <w>?</w> and
then selecting the hotkey for the search result. This will give a description
of the item or the contents of the shop.

The stash search string is case-insensitive.

<h>Searching by item properties:</h>

You can search for spell names (such as <w>Ignite Poison</w>) to find spellbooks
that contain the spell.

You can search for artefact item properties (such as <w>/prevents.*teleport</w>)
to find artefacts that have the property.

You can search by some additional item properties: <w>artefact</w> or
<w>artifact</w> will find identified artefacts, <w>ego</w> or <w>branded</w>
will find non-artefacts with a brand and unidentified items which may be
branded, <w>throwable</w> will find things you can throw, <w>dropped</w> will
find items you have dropped, <w>in_shop</w> will find items in shops, and (if
the autopickup_search option is enabled) <w>autopickup</w> will find items that
would be automatically picked up.

Skill names (such as <w>Polearms</w> or <w>Long Blades</w>) will find all weapons that
train that skill. You can also look for <w>melee weapon</w> and <w>ranged weapon</w>.

You can also search by item types such as <w>book</w> or <w>manual</w> or <w>jewellery</w>.
For armour slots, use <w>helmet</w> (all headgear), <w>gloves</w>, <w>shield</w>, and <w>body</w>.
Use <w>armour && !!body</w> to list all armour pieces except for body armour.

<h>Finding Dungeon Features:</h>

You can search for dungeon features by name: all shops will be found by a search
for <w>shop</w> (including shops that do not have "shop" in their name); other
dungeon features can also be found by name: <w>dispersal trap</w>, <w>altar</w>,
etc. You can also search for altars by deity name: <w>Zin</w>.

<h>Non-regex operators:</h>

You can use !! to negate a search string, && for a boolean AND, || for
boolean OR, and <<<< >> for grouping.

For instance, to find rings (jewellery) but not ring mail you could use:
<w>ring && !!mail</w>

Note that <w>/</w> and <w>=</w> apply to individual patterns, not the entire query:
you should search for <w>armour && /r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>, not
<w>/armour && r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>.

<w>throwable</w>会找出可以投掷的物品；

character-dump.english:
A: If you've got trouble even reaching the Temple, you might want to try a game
or two in hints mode for some general playing hints.

Also, there are easy playing combinations and more challenging ones (marked in
dark grey on the selection screen). If you are new to Crawl, sticking to the
easier ones is advisable. In general, treat each new monster you meet with
utmost caution, try to choose the location where you fight monsters, and keep
an eye on your health and magic.

For specific hints dealing with a particular character, you can press '#'
in-game to create a "character dump" in your morgue directory that details your
equipment, items, skilling, and available spells. You can share this with other
players to get feedback and advice through any of the community discussion
resources listed at http://crawl.develz.org/.
character-dump.chinese:
A: 如果你连神殿都很难到达，可以尝试用提示模式玩一两局，
获取一些通用的游戏提示。

此外，有些角色组合较简单，有些则更具挑战性（在选择界面中以深灰色标记）。
如果你刚接触Crawl，建议坚持选择较简单的组合。通常应当极其谨慎地对待
遇到的每种新怪物，尽量选择与怪物交战的地点，并随时留意生命值和法力。

如果需要针对特定角色的具体建议，可以在游戏中按'#'，
在morgue目录中创建一份详细列出装备、物品、技能训练和可用法术的“角色转储文件”。
你可以通过http://crawl.develz.org/列出的任一社区讨论渠道与其他玩家分享该文件，
获取反馈和建议。

fades away once the bonus reaches zero. The heavenly clouds prevent
invisibility, and obscure the vision of those outside the storm.

fugue.english:
Calls out to the lingering remnants of the long dead. While active, each
non-summoned enemy the caster or their allies slays attracts more vengeful
souls into the caster's weapon, temporarily enhancing their melee and ranged
effectiveness. When this bonus reaches its maximum, every hit will unleash a
glimmer of the dead's suffering, causing pain damage to each other foe adjacent
to your target.

Recasting this spell will release your grip on the souls you've attracted,
resetting any bonus you've accumulated, and the cacophonous wailing of the dead
may attract unwanted attention even while you maintain it.
fugue.chinese:
呼唤那些早已死去者留下的残念。在激活状态下，
施法者及其盟友每杀死一个非召唤的敌人就会吸引更多复仇的灵魂进入施法者的武器，
暂时提高其近战和远程攻击力。当这个加成达到最大值时，
每次命中都会释出死者一丝痛苦，对与目标相邻的其他敌人造成痛楚伤害。

重施这个法术会使你失去对吸引来的灵魂的控制，重置你积累的任何加成，
即使在维持此法术期间，死者刺耳的哀嚎也可能引来不必要的注意。

horror.english:
A mighty undead abomination, pieced together from the broken bones of many
dragons by powerful necromantic magic. The collective despair of such
desecrated dragons gives this horror its own undying breath weapon, in
billowing clouds of excruciating misery.

喷涌出令人痛不欲生的苦难云雾。

horror.english:
“I shall never forget that dawn, and the strange horror of seeing that my hands
 had become as clouded glass, and watching them grow clearer and thinner as the
 day went by, until at last I could see the sickly disorder of my room through
 them, though I closed my transparent eyelids. My limbs became glassy, the bones
 and arteries faded, vanished, and the little white nerves went last. I gritted
 my teeth and stayed there to the end. At last only the dead tips of the
 fingernails remained, pallid and white, and the brown stain of some acid, upon
 my fingers.”
    -H.G. Wells, _The Invisible Man_, Chapter 20. 1897
horror.chinese:
"我永远不会忘记那个黎明，以及看到我双手变得如磨砂玻璃一般的奇异恐怖，看着它们随着白日推移变得越来越清晰、越来越薄，直到最后我能透过它们看到我房间里的病态混乱，尽管我闭着透明的眼睑。我的四肢变得玻璃般透明，骨骼和动脉逐渐消隐、消失，最后消失的是那些白色的小神经。我咬紧牙关，在那里坚持到了最后。最终只剩下指甲末端，死气沉沉、苍白无色，还有我手指上某种酸液留下的褐色污渍。"
    ——H.G.威尔斯，《隐形人》，第二十章。1897年。

horror.english:
“The three of us were sitting ashen faced as if we had just witnessed a foul
 and malignant murder. At least if we had been watching a murder the murderer
 wouldn't have been looking us impassively in the eye as he did it. Maybe it
 was the feeling of cold unflinching arrogance that so disturbed us. But
 whatever malign emotions we tried to pin on to the lizard, we knew that they
 weren't the lizard's emotions at all, only ours. The lizard was simply going
 about its lizardly business in a simple, straightforward lizardly way. It
 didn't know anything about the horror, the guilt, the shame, the ugliness that
 we, uniquely guilty and ashamed animals, were trying to foist on it. So we got
 it all straight back at us, as if reflected in the mirror of its single
 unwavering and disinterested eye.”
    -Douglas Adams, “Last Chance to See”. 1990.
horror.chinese:
"我们三个面色惨白地坐着，仿佛刚刚目睹了一场肮脏而恶毒的谋杀。至少如果我们看的是谋杀，那个凶手也不会像眼下这样面无表情地直视着我们的眼睛。或许是那种冷酷而不为所动的傲慢感让我们如此不安。但无论我们试图将什么恶毒的情感强加到那只蜥蜴身上，我们都知道那根本不是蜥蜴的情感，而只是我们自己的。蜥蜴只不过在以简单直接的蜥蜴方式做它蜥蜴该做的事。它对那种恐惧、那种愧疚、那种羞耻、那种丑陋——我们这些唯一懂得愧疚和羞耻的动物试图强加给它的东西——一无所知。于是这一切都反弹回到我们身上，仿佛反射在它那只目光坚定而超然的眼睛的镜面中。"
    -Douglas Adams, "Last Chance to See". 1990.

horror.english:
“No — it wasn't that way at all. It was everywhere — a gelatin — a slime yet it
 had shapes, a thousand shapes of horror beyond all memory. There were eyes —
 and a blemish. It was the pit — the maelstrom — the ultimate abomination.
 Carter, it was the unnamable!”
    -H.P. Lovecraft, _The Unnamable_. 1925.

If you want to find the Orb of Zot, you'll need a much better costume than that.

You hope this place has the Orb of Zot, because it sure as hell doesn't have any candy.

Countless adventurers have entered the dungeon seeking the Orb of Zot, but there's always room for one more...

jewellery.english:
A: Apart from the standard items you'll find lying around in the dungeon, you
might also stumble upon artefacts which come in two varieties:

* randart: a random artefact, usually a weapon, armour or jewellery, with
  random properties such as conferring resistances or abilities.

* unrandart: a rarer variety of artefact that is predefined instead of randomly
  generated. Most unrandarts are identified on sight, and some come with
  special effects or unique abilities that are not available elsewhere.

Artefacts cannot be rebranded. They also normally cannot be enchanted, but
the artefact enchanting mutation allows scrolls of enchant weapon and enchant
armour to improve randart weapons and armour up to the normal enchantment
limits for mundane items of the same type. Unrandarts cannot be enchanted even
with this mutation.
jewellery.chinese:
A: 除了散落在地牢中的普通物品，你还可能遇到神器。神器分为两类：

* randart：随机神器，通常是武器、护甲或饰品，具有随机属性，
  例如提供抗性或能力。

* unrandart：较罕见的非随机神器，其属性预先定义，而非随机生成。
  大多数非随机神器一眼就能鉴定出来，只有一部分带有其他地方无法获得的
  特殊效果或独特能力。

jewellery.english:
<h>Searching the stash-tracker</h>

You can search for items and dungeon features by name (or a substring of the
name). In the list of search results, you can select a search result by its
hotkey to travel to its location.

Some examples of search strings:
<w>mutation</w>      find all potions of mutation, including potions in shops.
<w>throwing net</w>  finds every single throwing net and piles of nets.
<w>shop</w>          lists all shops. Press <w>!</w> and a shop's letter for the stock.
<w>Lair:2</w>        find everything known to be on Lair:2.
<w>/D:[2-4]</w>      finds everything on Dungeon levels 2-4. Regexes are allowed!
              Note that /D:[3-10] will not work as intended, since [x-y] is a
              regex character range.
<w>rPois</w>         finds all items with an rPois resistance.
<w>rC++</w>          finds all items with an rC++ resistance.
<w>+3</w>            finds all items with a +3 enchantment.
<w>/Lair.*axe</w> and <w>axe && Lair</w> both show all axes in the Lair.

Some shortcuts:
<w>.</w>             lists everything on your current level.
<w>..</w>            lists all items you know.
<w>0</w> to <w>9</w>        lists all items at the specified waypoint.
<w>*</w>             lists all items at all waypoints.
<w>@<<query></w>      lists everything matching <<query> on your current level.
<w>/<<regex></w>      lists items matching <<regex> as a regular expression.
<w>=<<string></w>     lists items containing <<string> as a substring.

You can also examine shops and items in the search results by pressing <w>?</w> and
then selecting the hotkey for the search result. This will give a description
of the item or the contents of the shop.

The stash search string is case-insensitive.

<h>Searching by item properties:</h>

You can search for spell names (such as <w>Ignite Poison</w>) to find spellbooks
that contain the spell.

You can search for artefact item properties (such as <w>/prevents.*teleport</w>)
to find artefacts that have the property.

You can search by some additional item properties: <w>artefact</w> or
<w>artifact</w> will find identified artefacts, <w>ego</w> or <w>branded</w>
will find non-artefacts with a brand and unidentified items which may be
branded, <w>throwable</w> will find things you can throw, <w>dropped</w> will
find items you have dropped, <w>in_shop</w> will find items in shops, and (if
the autopickup_search option is enabled) <w>autopickup</w> will find items that
would be automatically picked up.

Skill names (such as <w>Polearms</w> or <w>Long Blades</w>) will find all weapons that
train that skill. You can also look for <w>melee weapon</w> and <w>ranged weapon</w>.

You can also search by item types such as <w>book</w> or <w>manual</w> or <w>jewellery</w>.
For armour slots, use <w>helmet</w> (all headgear), <w>gloves</w>, <w>shield</w>, and <w>body</w>.
Use <w>armour && !!body</w> to list all armour pieces except for body armour.

<h>Finding Dungeon Features:</h>

You can search for dungeon features by name: all shops will be found by a search
for <w>shop</w> (including shops that do not have "shop" in their name); other
dungeon features can also be found by name: <w>dispersal trap</w>, <w>altar</w>,
etc. You can also search for altars by deity name: <w>Zin</w>.

<h>Non-regex operators:</h>

You can use !! to negate a search string, && for a boolean AND, || for
boolean OR, and <<<< >> for grouping.

For instance, to find rings (jewellery) but not ring mail you could use:
<w>ring && !!mail</w>

Note that <w>/</w> and <w>=</w> apply to individual patterns, not the entire query:
you should search for <w>armour && /r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>, not
<w>/armour && r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>.
jewellery.chinese:
<h>搜索储藏追踪器</h>

你可以按名称（或名称中的子字符串）搜索物品和地牢地标。
在搜索结果列表中，按搜索结果对应的热键，即可选择该结果并前往其位置。

搜索字符串示例：
<w>mutation</w>      找出所有变异药水，包括商店中的变异药水。
<w>throwing net</w>  找出每一张单独的投网以及成堆的投网。
<w>shop</w>          列出所有商店。按<w>!</w>，再按商店对应的字母即可查看库存。
<w>Lair:2</w>        找出已知位于兽巢第 2 层的所有东西。
<w>/D:[2-4]</w>      找出地牢第 2 至 4 层的所有东西。可以使用正则表达式！
              注意，/D:[3-10]不会按预期工作，因为[x-y]表示
              正则表达式中的字符范围。
<w>rPois</w>         找出所有具有rPois抗性的物品。
<w>rC++</w>          找出所有具有rC++抗性的物品。
<w>+3</w>            找出所有具有+3附魔的物品。
<w>/Lair.*axe</w>和<w>axe && Lair</w>都会显示兽巢中的所有斧头。

快捷方式：
<w>.</w>             列出当前层的所有东西。
<w>..</w>            列出你已知的所有物品。
<w>0</w>-<w>9</w>        列出指定导航点上的所有物品。
<w>*</w>             列出所有导航点上的所有物品。
<w>@<<query></w>      列出当前层所有与<<query>匹配的东西。
<w>/<<regex></w>      将<<regex>作为正则表达式，列出与之匹配的物品。
<w>=<<string></w>     列出包含<<string>这一子字符串的物品。

在搜索结果中按<w>?</w>，再按搜索结果对应的热键，还可以查看商店和物品。
系统会显示物品描述或商店库存。

储藏搜索字符串不区分大小写。

<h>按物品属性搜索：</h>

你可以搜索法术名称（如<w>点燃毒素</w>），找出包含该法术的法术书。

你可以搜索神器属性（如<w>/阻止.*传送</w>），找出具有该属性的神器。

你还可以按物品的其他属性搜索：
<w>artefact</w>或<w>artifact</w>会找出已鉴定的神器；
<w>ego</w>或<w>branded</w>会找出带有铭印的非神器，以及尚未鉴定、可能带有铭印的物品；
<w>throwable</w>会找出可以投掷的物品；
<w>dropped</w>会找出你丢弃过的物品；
<w>in_shop</w>会找出商店中的物品；
而（若启用了autopickup_search选项）<w>autopickup</w>会找出会被自动拾取的物品。

技能名称（如<w>Polearms</w>或<w>Long Blades</w>）会找出可训练该技能的所有武器。
你还可以搜索<w>melee weapon</w>和<w>ranged weapon</w>。

你也可以按物品类型搜索，如<w>book</w>、<w>manual</w>或<w>jewellery</w>。
对于护甲槽位，可以使用<w>helmet</w>（所有头部护具）、<w>gloves</w>、
<w>shield</w>和<w>body</w>。
使用<w>armour && !!body</w>会列出除躯干护甲以外的所有护甲。

<h>查找地牢地标：</h>

你可以按名称搜索地牢地标：搜索<w>shop</w>会找到所有商店
（包括名称中不含“shop”的商店）；其他地牢地标也可按名称找到，
如<w>dispersal trap</w>、<w>altar</w>等。
你还可以按神祇名称搜索祭坛：<w>辛</w>。

<h>非正则表达式运算符：</h>

可以用!!对搜索字符串取反，用&&表示逻辑与，用||表示逻辑或，
并用<<<< >>分组。

例如，要查找戒指（首饰）而不是环甲，可以使用：<w>ring && !!mail</w>。

请注意，<w>/</w>和<w>=</w>只作用于单个模式，而不是整个查询：
应当搜索<w>armour && /r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>，
而不是<w>/armour && r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>。

character-dump.english:
A: If you've got trouble even reaching the Temple, you might want to try a game
or two in hints mode for some general playing hints.

Also, there are easy playing combinations and more challenging ones (marked in
dark grey on the selection screen). If you are new to Crawl, sticking to the
easier ones is advisable. In general, treat each new monster you meet with
utmost caution, try to choose the location where you fight monsters, and keep
an eye on your health and magic.

For specific hints dealing with a particular character, you can press '#'
in-game to create a "character dump" in your morgue directory that details your
equipment, items, skilling, and available spells. You can share this with other
players to get feedback and advice through any of the community discussion
resources listed at http://crawl.develz.org/.
character-dump.chinese:
A: 如果你连神殿都很难到达，可以尝试用提示模式玩一两局，
获取一些通用的游戏提示。

此外，有些角色组合较简单，有些则更具挑战性（在选择界面中以深灰色标记）。
如果你刚接触Crawl，建议坚持选择较简单的组合。通常应当极其谨慎地对待
遇到的每种新怪物，尽量选择与怪物交战的地点，并随时留意生命值和法力。

如果需要针对特定角色的具体建议，可以在游戏中按'#'，
在morgue目录中创建一份详细列出装备、物品、技能训练和可用法术的“角色转储文件”。
你可以通过http://crawl.develz.org/列出的任一社区讨论渠道与其他玩家分享该文件，
获取反馈和建议。

Calls out to the lingering remnants of the long dead. While active, each
non-summoned enemy the caster or their allies slays attracts more vengeful
souls into the caster's weapon, temporarily enhancing their melee and ranged
effectiveness. When this bonus reaches its maximum, every hit will unleash a
glimmer of the dead's suffering, causing pain damage to each other foe adjacent
to your target.

Recasting this spell will release your grip on the souls you've attracted,
resetting any bonus you've accumulated, and the cacophonous wailing of the dead
may attract unwanted attention even while you maintain it.

horror.english:
A mighty undead abomination, pieced together from the broken bones of many
dragons by powerful necromantic magic. The collective despair of such
desecrated dragons gives this horror its own undying breath weapon, in
billowing clouds of excruciating misery.
horror.chinese:
这个强大的亡灵怪物，在强大的死灵术作用下由许多龙的断骨拼接而成。
这些遭亵渎巨龙的集体绝望，赋予了这怪物永不消逝的吐息武器，
喷涌出令人痛不欲生的苦难云雾。

horror.english:
“I shall never forget that dawn, and the strange horror of seeing that my hands
 had become as clouded glass, and watching them grow clearer and thinner as the
 day went by, until at last I could see the sickly disorder of my room through
 them, though I closed my transparent eyelids. My limbs became glassy, the bones
 and arteries faded, vanished, and the little white nerves went last. I gritted
 my teeth and stayed there to the end. At last only the dead tips of the
 fingernails remained, pallid and white, and the brown stain of some acid, upon
 my fingers.”
    -H.G. Wells, _The Invisible Man_, Chapter 20. 1897
horror.chinese:
"我永远不会忘记那个黎明，以及看到我双手变得如磨砂玻璃一般的奇异恐怖，看着它们随着白日推移变得越来越清晰、越来越薄，直到最后我能透过它们看到我房间里的病态混乱，尽管我闭着透明的眼睑。我的四肢变得玻璃般透明，骨骼和动脉逐渐消隐、消失，最后消失的是那些白色的小神经。我咬紧牙关，在那里坚持到了最后。最终只剩下指甲末端，死气沉沉、苍白无色，还有我手指上某种酸液留下的褐色污渍。"
    ——H.G.威尔斯，《隐形人》，第二十章。1897年。

horror.english:
“The three of us were sitting ashen faced as if we had just witnessed a foul
 and malignant murder. At least if we had been watching a murder the murderer
 wouldn't have been looking us impassively in the eye as he did it. Maybe it
 was the feeling of cold unflinching arrogance that so disturbed us. But
 whatever malign emotions we tried to pin on to the lizard, we knew that they
 weren't the lizard's emotions at all, only ours. The lizard was simply going
 about its lizardly business in a simple, straightforward lizardly way. It
 didn't know anything about the horror, the guilt, the shame, the ugliness that
 we, uniquely guilty and ashamed animals, were trying to foist on it. So we got
 it all straight back at us, as if reflected in the mirror of its single
 unwavering and disinterested eye.”
    -Douglas Adams, “Last Chance to See”. 1990.
horror.chinese:
"我们三个面色惨白地坐着，仿佛刚刚目睹了一场肮脏而恶毒的谋杀。至少如果我们看的是谋杀，那个凶手也不会像眼下这样面无表情地直视着我们的眼睛。或许是那种冷酷而不为所动的傲慢感让我们如此不安。但无论我们试图将什么恶毒的情感强加到那只蜥蜴身上，我们都知道那根本不是蜥蜴的情感，而只是我们自己的。蜥蜴只不过在以简单直接的蜥蜴方式做它蜥蜴该做的事。它对那种恐惧、那种愧疚、那种羞耻、那种丑陋——我们这些唯一懂得愧疚和羞耻的动物试图强加给它的东西——一无所知。于是这一切都反弹回到我们身上，仿佛反射在它那只目光坚定而超然的眼睛的镜面中。"
    -Douglas Adams, "Last Chance to See". 1990.

horror.english:
“No — it wasn't that way at all. It was everywhere — a gelatin — a slime yet it
 had shapes, a thousand shapes of horror beyond all memory. There were eyes —
 and a blemish. It was the pit — the maelstrom — the ultimate abomination.
 Carter, it was the unnamable!”
    -H.P. Lovecraft, _The Unnamable_. 1925.
horror.chinese:
"不——根本不是那样。它无处不在——一种凝胶——一种黏液，
 却有着形态，千种超出一切记忆的恐怖形态。那里有眼睛——
 还有一种污迹。那是深渊——大漩涡——终极的憎恶。
 卡特，那是不可名状之物！"
    -H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状》。1925年。

You hope this place has the Orb of Zot, because it sure as hell doesn't have any candy.
